var text AM = ToText([Quote AM Name]);
var text LessLast = SearchAndReplace($AM,ToText([Most Recent Quote AM Name])," ");

If([Most Recent Matches Cust?]=true,
  List(" | ",
     If(Contains($AM,"Ehab Kamel")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Ehab Kamel","Ehab Kamel"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Jacky Chan")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Jacky Chan","Jacky Chan"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Nic Doyle")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Nic Doyle","Nic Doyle"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Mary Serratore-Howe")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Mary Serratore-Howe","Mary Serratore-Howe"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Linda D'Arcy")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Linda D'Arcy","Linda D'Arcy"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Peter Musarra")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Peter Musarra","Peter Musarra"),
     If(Contains($AM,"Kenneth Beck-Pedersen")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Kenneth Beck-Pedersen","Kenneth Beck-Pedersen")
  ),
  List(" | ",                       //most recent is not a match of Act Mgr, so remove most recent as well
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Ehab Kamel")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Ehab Kamel","Ehab Kamel"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Jacky Chan")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Jacky Chan","Jacky Chan"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Nic Doyle")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Nic Doyle","Nic Doyle"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Mary Serratore-Howe")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Mary Serratore-Howe","Mary Serratore-Howe"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Linda D'Arcy")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Linda D'Arcy","Linda D'Arcy"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Peter Musarra")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Peter Musarra","Peter Musarra"),
     If(Contains($LessLast,"Kenneth Beck-Pedersen")=true and [Customer AM] <> "Kenneth Beck-Pedersen","Kenneth Beck-Pedersen")
  )
)
[Customer AM] = ToText([Most Recent Quote AM Name])
If([Most Recent Matches Cust?]=false,ToText([Most Recent Quote AM Name]))

If(Length(ToText([Most Recent Accepted Quote Date]))>0,
   ToDays(Today()-[Most Recent Accepted Quote Date]),
   9999)
